entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted open source. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term memory workflows built around retain, recall, and reflect operations. It supports hosted and local LLM providers and can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. It supports scoped semantic search and archives sessions as inspectable Markdown memories.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source memory platform for agents that structures text into entities, relationships, and searchable chunks. Custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP support let teams shape the memory and connect agents.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts, handles contradictions, and manages automatic forgetting. It can process PDFs, images, videos, and code, and includes connectors for services such as Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It shares memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents and the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It processes stored information in the background to update peer representations, with Python and TypeScript SDKs, a CLI, and managed, local, and self-hosted deployment options.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repository, providing Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations for a context tree. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with five-tier retrieval and an interactive TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents that describes itself as zero-dependency and sub-millisecond. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK and uses one pure-Python dependency.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciling conflicting information and managing forgetting. It also supports exchanging memories through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, with a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness for helping agents succeed on complex tasks. It evaluates task runs, keeps useful lessons while discarding dead ends, and produces traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches session histories already stored on disk across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, and other supported agents, including sessions from months ago. It can also resume a session or continue it in another agent, and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: hermes-lcm is a Hermes Agent plugin for lossless context management, persisting messages in SQLite with a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from that stored context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: honcho-self-hosted provides Hermes Agent with private, cross-session memory through a self-hosted Honcho backend. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that can carry state across Hermes Agent and other supported agents and clients. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions, and offers a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions; it can run locally or as a team server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur gives multi-agent systems a shared memory layer stored as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It offers local search with keyword search as a fallback, plus CLI setup and an MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25 and vector search with rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores durable agent memory locally in a SQLite file and provides FTS5 search with a five-tier schema. Its five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and LangGraph BaseStore, without requiring a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for cache sharing, supporting text and multimodal context along with reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling. It integrates with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: yantrikdb-hermes-plugin is a self-maintaining memory plugin for Hermes Agent, using an embedded backend by default with an HTTP option. Each recall includes a why_retrieved reason, and the plugin also provides contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn keeps long-term, cross-project memory in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and connects to coding agents through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI that proactively recalls, maintains, and evolves persistent knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd uses an anticipatory cache that watches agent session logs to prefetch context, combining RAG with vector search. It stores data locally with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner for Hermes. It uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to manage state and retrieval, then provides the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search with BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal, and can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. Its edge tags create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes, making it a reflective memory option for agents.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migrations, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall is designed to surface higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with pre-LLM-call and session-end hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit trace of prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, so deleted events are not retained for future recall.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers a session’s original goal from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys, making it a payment-focused option in this list.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin runs inside Hermes and communicates with XMemo over HTTPS for durable cross-session memory. It provides ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for searching and manually storing memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Sourcevault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands cover search, file reads, context, and Q&A, while repo sync and indexed git-history search support its Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop integrations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval, and can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory tools for Hermes Agent, including 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can automatically checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit curates agent memory stored in plain Markdown files, producing JSON diffs for review rather than using a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides an agentic skills framework and software development workflow covering specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Its skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and the README includes installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for creating and refining interactive web prototypes with a live preview, as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics. Its skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins make it a design-focused addition to a Hermes Agent skills list.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its listed compatibility with over 26 AI platforms makes it a broad cybersecurity resource for agents.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Incremental sync preserves manual layouts and annotations, and the project also provides the diagramctl CLI with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds verification and dispute resolution, bringing these capabilities together in an agent skill for agent-to-agent commerce.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing scores files or piped text for AI-writing patterns and can rewrite content with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw unifies skills across agents and devices, with support for Hermes, Codex, Claude Code, and other agents. Its dashboard covers skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for Claude Code and agents that support agentskills.io. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides professional agent skills with frameworks, output templates, quality checks, and anti-patterns, and the README describes 21 skills designed for unattended use. It runs natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with installation through `npx pm-claude-skills add` or Claude Code's plugin directory.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube skills supports transcript retrieval, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries sourced from Git or S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files from them with a tangler. When source files change, it syncs those edits back into the literate document, making it useful for keeping code and documentation together across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates documents as PASS or FAIL.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute workflow. It does not require a background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, plus CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, connecting an agent’s recorded work with model handoffs.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides covering installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. It belongs here as a Portuguese-language community resource, with contributions submitted through pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides FLUX image and video prompting skills, along with BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills, making it a focused option for FLUX generation workflows.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills specification, and can be installed with npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also includes skill testing and export, covering creation through validation.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika uses a workflow language with four verbs and a single Rust binary, and can run with a model you choose. It checks workflows before calling a model and verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with both a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. Its installation support resolves dependencies recursively, and it also includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with checkpoints and real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path when execution needs to be undone.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for discovering, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and is described as operating autonomously around the clock via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills considered before LLM calls to reduce token usage. Its five-layer retrieval combines hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, and dense embeddings with RRF fusion, and it can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only, adversarial code reviews using parallel subagents focused on edge cases, adversarial review, and integration analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans with tools such as semgrep and bandit, then verifies findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a local personal execution system where habits recur and are scored daily, while tasks cover other activities. It stores data in SQLite, includes an Android client, and connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This Hermes Agent skill simplifies code through parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents, with support for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Its tiered application process includes an approval gate, making it distinct from code-review skills focused on finding problems.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings together cybersecurity skills, tools, and frameworks, including 2,077 total skills across multiple repositories and 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for breaking tasks into multiple stories, with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C#/.NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, real-time observability dashboard covering token costs, session history, skill analytics, and other agent activity. It enforces read-only data access with local log desensitization, and optionally sends incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown agent skills for code review and session management, including session reconciliation, worktree recovery, and skill scaffolding. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer, and the collection supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: Creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs, generating VHS tape or Playwright recording scripts for terminal tools, web apps, and libraries. It also optimizes GIFs to target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Builds Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field changes.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: Provides terminal and MCP access to a catalog of more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, with installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Analyzes past agent sessions and installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals, with proposals kept review-only by default. Its evaluation gate supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Packages skills for social data, web research, and enrichment, including bundles that combine an agent, skills, and a data flow. It also welcomes community contributions in `skills/community/`.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Provides Hermes Agent skills for routing file operations with environment-specific path syntax and selecting existing, project-compatible Python interpreters. It supports native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers tools for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removing common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracting structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. The collection also includes an e-commerce materials studio.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: Lets agents find open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review, with public wallet earnings records. Board creation returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers, then issues certificates signed with Ed25519. It also provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Provides Hermes Agent access to structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools. It also includes five workflow skills.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Provides risk checks for token honeypots, taxes, and liquidity, alongside market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This skill helps AI agents join KissCode, with a one-call registration example and SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md files. It also lists installation options for several agent platforms and includes a README badge snippet.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings at scales ranging from global to street level, with core conclusions and action suggestions. It can also use user interests from semantic memory to expand searches, making it a fit for agents that need tailored news summaries.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This MCP server provides Western and Vedic astrology results through an endpoint with no authentication, and describes its results as deterministic and verifiable with SHA-256 hashes. Per-call REST payment is available through x402 or MPP, setting it apart as an astrology tool with verification and payment options.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage while discovering server metadata and tool schemas incrementally. Its socket-based daemon architecture maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct fit for Hermes Agent skills that need MCP access.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and automatically updates its packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` commands for the listed tools, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. It also documents OpenClaw setup and access to device hardware and UI through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct and CRD-based deployment workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image with mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This project provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation options via an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a deployment option with documented configuration examples and a Kubernetes install check.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local, pre-indexed project graph with `codegraph init` and auto-syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects the graph to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI for tracking token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. It also provides a visualization dashboard for analyzing usage, making it useful for comparing activity across clients.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor is a real-time widget for token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools. It reads Hermes Agent usage from its state database and includes historical trends and usage breakdowns.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance to help build interfaces with AI. It connects to coding tools through TypeUI MCP or plugins and supports AI providers that accept Markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop with seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for skins and themes for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files, and custom skins inherit unspecified values from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content, including configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows, with a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized around two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with a stated 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configuration and skills. It can switch between default and scoped agents, with project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes Agent. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco is a self-healing observability tool for AI agents, with a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time conversation telemetry. Its monitoring offers zero-token passive analysis or scheduled active probing, and uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with offline operation that requires no API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default, with explicit approval required for consequential actions and external writes. It includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with versions for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with 21 built-in professional assistants. It also supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent, with a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a companion app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for managing Hermes Agent chats, sessions, and integrations, including channels such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It also supports visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, and Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace brings chat, a terminal, memory browsing, skills management, and an inspector into a native web workspace. It includes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that brings sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal offers direct shell access for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, as well as chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted connections. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streaming chats with file or image attachments, browsing and resuming server sessions, and viewing scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI monitor with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for sessions from Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets users search prompts, tool activity, errors, and file paths, track Codex and Claude quota burn per session, and builds its search index locally.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, with a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel. It also provides streaming chat with tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox handles requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a review step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also brings together a kanban board for agentic work and controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally running, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its terminal chat supports streaming responses and file attachments, while the app also offers dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 Telegram validation and background spawning for up to five concurrent agents.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop app with a dark-themed, multilingual GUI and session management. It includes workflow automation and runtime tool creation, and supports local models through LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task tracking sit alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a dashboard for monitoring and configuring Hermes. It shows session activity and cost tracking, supports inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, and provides read-only views of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It combines a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers with isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native multi-agent client with streaming chat, model switching, and collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. Its visual Skill Store offers more than 50 curated one-click installations, distinguishing it from session-monitoring dashboards.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin for the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard shows configured model routes across profiles in one matrix and lets you preview changes before applying them. Named presets and guarded Undo make it suited to people who want to switch models across profiles with a way to review and reverse changes.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent supports command approvals, live tool-step updates, and interactive answer cards for checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It runs on Android, web, and macOS, with a Linux alpha, making it a cross-platform chat interface rather than a dashboard model-switching plugin.
